Q: adding values from a group by A:

Model method implementing query builder:

public function getScoresByTime(): array
{
    return $this->db
        ->select('created_time')
        ->select_sum('score')
        ->group_by('created_time')
        ->get('traineescoretest')
        ->result();
}

The rendered SQL will be fully quoted:

SELECT `created_time`, SUM(`score`) AS `score`
FROM `traineescoretest`
GROUP BY `created_time`

Chaining the method calls is most elegant and how the methods were intended to be used.

The result() method can be directly chained to the query builder calls after the get() call executes the built query. The returned payload will be an array of zero or more objects.

Q: How to solve the pytorch RuntimeError: Numpy is not available without upgrading numpy to the latest version because of other dependencies A:

Getting same error for numpy 2.0 as of March 18th 2025.

Current solution is to install the latest version of numpy 1 (1.26.4) instead:

pip install "numpy<2"

You will likely have to restart the kernel afterwards.

Q: Has Windows an integrated built-in C/C++ compiler package? A:

Windows has a built-in compiler for C# but not C or C++. Similar to most Linux distros, you have to install it manually, because most people don't do programming and never use compilers anyway so it's pointless to install them by default

The native equivalent to Debian apt in Windows is winget. You can check out its source code here. Currently there are a few GCC packages that you can find:

> winget search gcc
Name                       Id                              Version      Match    Source
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
GNU Arm Embedded Toolchain Arm.GnuArmEmbeddedToolchain     13.3 2024.07 Tag: gcc winget
CrossWorks for ARM         Rowley.CrossWorks               4.8          Tag: gcc winget
AVR-GCC                    ZakKemble.avr-gcc               14.1.0       Tag: gcc winget
libjpeg-turbo SDK for GCC  libjpeg-turbo.libjpeg-turbo.GCC 3.0.4                 winget

The results above are mostly cross-compilers and aren't targeting Windows though, so you can use them to compile code but you have to run on another platform

Until the GCC guys create a winget package, the simplest way as of now is to install LLVM instead, which is the other major cross-platform compiler collection apart from GCC

winget install LLVM     # OR winget install --id=LLVM.LLVM -e

But you should really install an IDE, which have built-in compilers or a simple method to install compilers for use with them. Programming on a simple text editor without IDE features is only applicable for very early learning stages

The "native" and most famous IDE for Windows is Visual Studio, which also has cl.exe built-in; zero configuration is needed after installation. Visual Studio Code is another well-known IDE, also available for Linux and macOS, and can be configured to use any compilers. Other commonly used IDEs being Code::Blocks and Dev-C++, which are typically bundled with GCC. But IMHO they're just for small simple projects, VS and VS Code are much better

Below are some IDEs that you can install from winget

winget install VSCodium
winget install --id=Microsoft.VisualStudioCode.CLI -e
winget install --id=Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.Community -e
winget install --id=Microsoft.VisualStudio.2019.BuildTools -e
winget install --id=Embarcadero.Dev-C++ -e
winget install --id=Codeblocks.Codeblocks -e
winget install --id=CodeLite.CodeLite -e
winget install --id=Orwell.Dev-C++ -e
winget install --id=RoyQu.RedPanda-C++ -e

You can find more related packages

winget search compile
winget search ide
winget search C++

You can also search for winget packages online using this or this

There are also 3rd party solutions like Chocolatey or Scoop. They're not native Windows tools so you have to install them first before using them to install packages

choco install mingw
choco install visualcpp-build-tools
choco install vscode.install
choco install orwelldevcpp
choco install llvm
choco install codeblocks
choco install msys2
choco install embarcaderodevcpp

scoop install main/mingw
scoop install versions/tdm-gcc
scoop install main/gcc
scoop install versions/gcc-msys
